headline: The AES Corp's Dividend Analysis
summary: The AES Corp (NYSE:AES) recently announced a total dividend of $0.18 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-07-31.  This payment includes a $0.18 per share cash dividend, payable on 2026-08-14.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
